name: UI — Ícono de Carga de Muro (HUD contador de muros)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo ícono centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 24×24.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon HUD icon centered on a fully transparent background. The icon is a WALL BRICK icon for a game HUD counter — represents one deployable wall charge. A single chunky cartoon rectangular brick / wall tile, wider than tall (roughly 2:1 ratio). Bright cyan-blue (#2288FF) with bold cel-shading: bright sky-blue highlight across the top edge, medium cyan-blue body, dark navy-blue shadow along the bottom edge. A faint brick mortar line across the middle. Bold dark charcoal outline, 4-5px thick. The shape is INSTANTLY readable as a WALL TILE even at 24x24px — wide, flat, solid. Transparent background, nothing else.
frames.negative_prompt: background, scenery, realistic, photorealistic, pixel art, sphere, coin, bullet, green, text, watermark, cube 3D, isometric perspective, complex detail
